efficients are small, so the law is close to a plain cubic in P.

I did not identify a closed-form physical interpretation (e.g. logistic or Allee terms) for these coefficients, and the fitted constants are only as precise as the least-squares fit. Time t has no detectable effect on the growth rate.

best.code:
def equation(t, P, params):
    num = params[0] + params[1]*P + params[2]*P**2 + params[3]*P**3
    den = 1 + params[4]*P + params[5]*P**2
    return num/den
